name: Conversational AI & Voice Assistants
summary: Building spoken and text assistants end to end, from wake-word detection and speech recognition to dialogue management, LLM tool use and low-latency speech output.

topics.name: Voice assistant architecture: wake word, ASR, NLU, dialogue, NLG, TTS
Voice activity detection, endpointing and turn-taking
Natural language understanding: intent classification and slot filling
Dialogue state tracking and dialogue management
LLM-based assistants with tools, memory and personalization
Streaming and latency engineering: barge-in and full-duplex conversation
On-device versus cloud processing and privacy
Multimodal assistants combining voice and vision
Evaluation: task success, latency and user satisfaction
Safety, security and privacy for always-listening devices
